user_message: what is a front-end offer in plain English?
assistant_message:
A front-end offer is the first thing you sell or offer to turn a stranger or lead into a customer.

In Money Models language, this is usually called an attraction offer. Its job is not to maximize total profit by itself; its job is to get people in the door and ideally pay back, or liquidate, what it cost you to acquire that customer [offer-types:4]. It sits at the start of the offer stack, before upsells, downsells, or continuity offers [make-your-money-model:2].

Plain English: it is the "first yes" offer. For your design business, the $597 STR Design Diagnostic is a front-end offer because it gives a qualified owner a lower-friction first purchase before the larger full-service design project.
